name: site/section
title: Section
summary: The standard marketing page band: a <section> with the vertical rhythm, a background surface and an optional hairline divider, wrapping its content in the site container unless it is full-bleed.

props.name: border
props.description: A hairline bottom border (`border-b border-border`), the quiet section divider.

props.name: container
props.description: Wrap the content in `.container-custom`; false renders it full-bleed.

props.name: id
props.description: The section's id, for in-page links.

props.name: class
props.description: Extra classes, appended after the rhythm, surface and border classes.

behaviour: Renders one <section data-slot="section"> whose class is the rhythm utility, then the surface, then the border, then `class`, space-separated with empty parts dropped.
With `container` (the default) the content sits in one <div class="container-custom">; without it the content is the section's direct child.
It adds no heading and no landmark name: a section is labelled by the heading its content brings.

secondary-tight.description: Tight rhythm on the secondary surface, with a divider, an id and an extra class.

full-bleed.description: Loose, transparent and full-bleed: no container.

keyboard: None of its own: it is a layout band.
aria: No aria of its own; an unnamed <section> is not a landmark, so the heading inside carries the structure.

theming.brandOverlay: Nothing: the surfaces and the divider are neutral tokens.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: The `.section*` utilities set the vertical padding per breakpoint; `.container-custom` sets the max width and the responsive side gutters.
contract:
contract
  slot is "section"
  class is "section bg-canvas"
  when secondary-tight class is "section-tight bg-secondary border-b border-border relative"
  when full-bleed class is "section-loose"
  when default shows h2 "Our work"
end

checks.say: The content sits in one site container.
The id is on the section.
Full-bleed content is the section's direct child.

gaps: The `.section`, `.section-tight`, `.section-loose` and `bg-canvas` utilities live in each consuming site's globals.css; the registry does not ship them.
There is no way to name the band (aria-labelledby) so it becomes a region landmark.
